answer: A borrowed lamp cannot certify two cores. An applicant escrows 7.35 POA and draws one sealed shale tablet bound to their pubkey at a seed-chosen adit. They have 12 minutes to extract the 11.4 g kernel, assay it to 0.04 g, and hang a 19-bit lantern hash of tablet-id, kernel mass, and epoch seed on the reserved hook in seconds 18-47. Eighty-four aliases would freeze 617.40 POA and need eighty-four exclusive tablets. Wardens re-weigh the kernel and replay the adit draw from the seed. A reused tablet, mass drift over 0.04 g, or a copied lantern code burns 47% and rests that adit for 6 epochs.
